notes.title: Update v1.1.0
notes.content:
The following issues have been solved on this update:
[list]
[*] Added event recollection function to Battle Simulation room.
[*] Some skill descriptions will now change as the skill levels up.
[*] Fixed some minor bugs.
[/list]
※ If you installed an additional patch on your Steam version, we recommend redownloading and reinstalling it.
※ A warning might show up after opening the game. You can ignore it by clicking on "Continue Anyway".

Regards,

Saikey Studios Team

notes.title: English Version Only - Hotfix v1.0.8
notes.content:
We have submitted a new small update fixing some critical issues!
Some of the files in our previous update were outdated.
Many of you were having crashes due this issue.

[b]Next Update[/b]
We are currently fixing additional minor bugs and translation mistakes. 
A new, bigger update, for both the main game and the demo will be submitted in the following days.

We apologize for the issues.

Thanks to all the thousands of players supporting Tunnel Escape!

Edit: Updated to v1.0.8

tags.bug: - Many of you were having crashes due this issue.

notes.title: Update v1.0.6
notes.content:
The following issues have been solved on this update:

[list]
[*] The game would crash in some areas.
[*] Active skills will no longer be displayed in the menu during non-combat situations.
[*] Fixed the issue where flash grenades couldn't damage “Knight Elite α”.
[*] Corrected some text errors.
[/list]

If you installed an additional patch on your Steam version, we recommend redownloading and reinstalling it.
If some of these issues persist after updating, you will new to start a new game save.

Regards,

Saikey Studios Team
